review:
The Dog House Megaways 1000 brings the dogs back on Megaways reels, with wild multipliers worth up to 1,000x. When several multiplier wilds land on one spin, their values are multiplied together before applying to the win, which is where the big hits come from.

Three to six scatters trigger up to 20 free spins and a choice of two modes: sticky wilds that stay put, or random wilds with up to six landing each spin. Super scatters in the trigger unlock stronger versions of the bonus. Pragmatic lists a 96.50% RTP. It suits experienced players chasing very large multipliers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
